{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicate patient_id
print(f'Duplicate patient_id count: {df.duplicated(subset="patient_id").sum()}')

# Check how many rows have biomarker_baseline == -999
print(f'Rows with biomarker_baseline == -999: {(df["biomarker_baseline"] == -999).sum()}')

# Check the unique patient_id count vs total rows
total_rows = len(df)
unique_patients = df["patient_id"].nunique()
print(f'Total rows: {total_rows}, Unique patients: {unique_patients}')"}
